name: Nikaidou Hiro
source:
"This village is not right.
— It must be corrected."
Nikaido Hiro.

An outsider to the village, a girl who always strives for 'Righteousness'. She cares deeply for her allies, and maintains a calm disposition no matter the situation. Reliable as she is, she also has an extremely stern side to her, and shows no mercy to that which she deems 'not right'.

Flower: Red Spider Lily.
Bloom Factor: [???]
Magic: [???]
[Translated from [url=https://mahoumura.com/]Official Site[/url]]
